Libraries
```{r setup}

#for mefisto 
library(reticulate)
reticulate::use_condaenv("mofa2_env", required = TRUE)
reticulate::py_config()
reticulate::py_module_available("mofapy2")

library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(Biobase)
library(ggplot2)
library(svdx)
library(svdxBenchmark)

```

```{r}
#iobw download 
indices <- read.table( file="./dengue_iobw/climateData/M_Oce_Er.txt",header=T ) %>% 
  as_tibble( rownames="yearmonth" ) 

iobwDownload <- read.csv( file="./dengue_iobw/ncc_climate_indices_monthly.csv", header=T)
```


```{r load-raw}
iobw <- readRDS( file="./dengue_iobw/dengueAll.RDS" )
pd <- pData(iobw$authorDat)
pd <-pd %>%
  left_join( iobwDownload, by=c("year", "month") )
stopifnot( all(pd$date.x == pd$date.y))
pd$date <- pd$date.x

rownames(pd) <- colnames(iobw$authorDat)
es <- ExpressionSet( assayData=exprs(iobw$authorDat[,-1]), #no detrend value for the first starting point in author data
                     phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame( pd[-1,] ),
                     featureData = featureData( iobw$authorDat )
                     )

```


# Define svdx specs
```{r}
fdata <- fData(es)
Y_raw <- exprs(es)
xdata <- pData(es)
zdata <- xdata


xformula <- ~ month * iobw_lag_1_3
.modelType <- list( "month" = list( "cubic", range(xdata$month) ),
                    "iobw_lag_1_3" = list( "cubic", range(xdata$iobw_lag_1_3) )
                    )
zformula <- ~ 1
row_offsets <- rep(0, nrow(es))
col_offsets <- rep(0, ncol(es))
t_j <- NULL

```

# Preprocess

For the non-family SVDX, we use `family = NULL`.

Because sparse row-centering densifies the matrix, either use dense input or set `center_rows = FALSE` for sparse input unless we intentionally allow densification.

```{r preprocess}
fdata <- as_svdx_fdata(
  fdata,
  feature_col = "country", #these are the rownames in the circ data
  label_col = "country", #these are what we will use for labeling features in plots
  enrichment_col = "country" #these are what we will use for enrichment when we do inferecne
)

prepared <- svdx:::prepare_svdx_data(
  Y = Y_raw,
  xdata = xdata,
  zdata = zdata,
  xformula = xformula,
  modelType = .modelType, 
  zformula = zformula,
  fdata = fdata,
  family = NULL, 
  log1p_transform = FALSE,              #already transformed      
  t_j = rep(0, ncol(Y_raw)),
  normalize = FALSE,                    #data has already been normalization
  top_ftrs = 5000,
  center_rows = TRUE,    
  scale_rows = TRUE,
  allow_sparse_densification = TRUE,
  col_offset = rep(0, ncol(Y_raw)),
  row_offset = rep(0, nrow(Y_raw)),
  dataset_name = "dengue"
)
```


Run 
```{r}


METHODS <- c(
  "svdx",
  "pca",
  "mefisto_duplicate_view", 
  "nmf",
  "mixomics_pls",
  "spca",
  "sparse_nmf"
)
SPCA_KEEPX_GRID <- round(c(0.01, 0.25, 0.5) * nrow(prepared$Y))
SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID <- 10^c(-3, -2, -1)

rw_single <- run_real_world_single_benchmark(
  
  Y = prepared$Y,
  data = prepared$xdata,
  xformula = prepared$xformula,
  zdata = prepared$zdata,
  zformula = prepared$zformula,
  fdata = fdata, 
  
  K = 15,

  methods = METHODS,
  inference_methods = c("svdx", "svdx_adjusted"), ftol_abs = 1e-5, 
  
  train_fraction = 1,
  
  run_factorization = TRUE,
  run_inference = FALSE,
  
  modelType = prepared$modelType
  
)


rw <- runSingleBenchmarkReports( rw_single = rw_single, components = 1:10,
                                    outdir = "./dengue_iobw_interactions", overwrite=T, 
                                 color=NULL, group=NULL, line_group = NULL, xaxis="date", 
                                 u_plot_specs = list(list("connect"=T)), 
                                 loading_enrichment = F
                                 )

```
